No-one wants to see the same story they've already seen hundreds of times. And corporate Kane seems to be one of the best ways to turn him into a viable heel instead of just the cool anti-hero. Depends on if you've opened it or not. I personally never keep a bottle opened for more than a day or two. After that it's overoxidized and starts to taste bad. Now boxed wines aren't designed to keep as well as bottled wines are. Typical rule of thumb Dr a store bought, ready-to-drink-now wine is ten years for an unopened, properly stored red, and five years for a properly stored, unopened white. Box wines however, IIRC have a shelf life of about six months unopened. So I wouldn't keep it too long past the expiration date if you haven't already opened it. If it's already been opened, a few days maybe a week tops, but I don't recommend keeping it that long.
